summary.text: Don Hewett is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 22-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Beth Doglio (D).
An electrical engineer and Air Force veteran, he was the Republican candidate for Washington's 10th Congressional District in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Don Hewett was born in Pittsfield, Massachusetts, and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1982 to 1986.
He earned bachelor's degrees in mathematics and computer science from the University of Washington in 1985 and later a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.
His career experience includes working at Microsoft, Boeing and Intel, and he served in the security police in the Air Force.
In the 2024 general election for U.S. House in Washington's 10th District, Hewett lost to incumbent Marilyn Strickland (D), 41.2 percent to 58.5 percent.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a regular working person rather than a professional politician and said he is passionate about what he called Washington state's overreach into personal lives.
He also said Washington state does not have an income problem but a spending problem.
